items.title: Frank Netto Interview, 1986-11-10
items.q: I think Tony had left the Liberty then. ... Tony's brother. ... DeFranco. Tony DeFranco. ... when Abby Brunus was down there playing on the job, and Tony come in loaded, laying.

ctx.x: This was no cheap affair. I mean, it was... Did you take it down to your studio? Did you take it down to your studio? No, no, no, no.

You ought to see that. Not Hazel. I was in there. I got a key from him over there. No, no, no, no. He had 700 keys there. If the red light was on, don't come in. If the red light was on. He'll come back later. Well, I think Tony had left the Liberty then.
When Von Gatwood... Could you tell me? Yeah.
